name: Spokeo
notes: First search your name on spokeo.com and open your actual listing — the opt-out form needs that specific profile URL (e.g. spokeo.com/Smith-Sample/Houston/TX/p12345678), not just your email.

name: BeenVerified
notes: Cloudflare human-verification check often appears before the form loads — just complete it.

name: MyLife
notes: Known to be aggressive about re-listing; check carefully on recheck. Page can render blank on first load (Cloudflare bot-check) — reload if that happens.

name: Nuwber
notes: nuwber.com itself appears to be down (confirmed dead as of Oct 2026). Nuwber Inc. is still an active registered data broker though — email support@nuwber.com directly to request opt-out/deletion, or call (844) 912-1292. Worth rechecking occasionally in case the site comes back.

name: FamilyTreeNow
notes: URL is correct even though it looks like a search form — per their own FAQ, you locate your record, confirm by email, then an opt-out action appears for that record. Often sits behind a Cloudflare "verify you're human" check first.

name: AdvancedBackgroundChecks
notes: Page is titled "opt out of sale and sharing" (CCPA legal wording) and doesn't obviously say "remove me" — it's the real removal flow anyway. Enter name+email, click the confirmation link they email you, then fill out the actual opt-out form that opens. Can take up to 45 days to fully process (slower than most of these).
